svg.text: All the red coefficients [k, v] are set by the population level
(e.g., GenTime, Iteroparity; posterior draws from Stage 1)

text.tspan: X ∈ { γ, βintra, βgrass, βshrub, βclimate }

svg.text: Size [i, t] & Local environment [q, t] (z & E)
Σx θx[v] × z[i, t] × Wx[i, t]
Σx ωx[v] × E[q, t] × Wx[i, t]
Crowding by conspecifics, grasses & shrubs [i, t] (Wx)
Crowding index (one kernel for all species)
Wx[i, t] = Σn ∈ x F(dn) × An
intra: neighbours of the same species (its own size measure)
grass: other species, basal area; shrub: other species, canopy area
Linear predictor for individual i, population k, quadrat q, year t, vital rate v
η[i, t, v] = ηind[i, t, v] + ηplot[q, v] + ηcrowd[i, t, v] + ηclim[i, t, v] + ηyear[i, t, v]
NegBin( C′ × exp ηR[k, q, t] , r )
C′ = p × quadrat cover + (1 − p) × group mean cover; ηR uses quadrat cover in place of z and W
